label: Cleaning service
about: Home and office cleaning: regular cleans, deep cleans and end-of-tenancy cleaning.
booking_question: What kind of clean, and roughly how big is the place? (e.g. regular clean, 2-bedroom flat) Include your address or area.

faqs.q: Do you bring cleaning products? | supplies | equipment | products
faqs.a: Yes, we bring all products and equipment. If you prefer we use your own, just tell us.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home? | keys | key holding
faqs.a: No, many clients leave us a key. We keep keys safely and labelled without your address.

faqs.q: Are your cleaners insured and vetted? | trusted | background check | insurance
faqs.a: Yes, all our cleaners are vetted and we're fully insured.

faqs.q: Can I have the same cleaner every time? | same person
faqs.a: Yes, for regular cleans we always try to send the same cleaner.

faqs.q: What if I'm not happy? | guarantee | satisfaction
faqs.a: Tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and re-clean the area for free.

faqs.q: How do I cancel or change a booking? | cancel | reschedule
faqs.a: Just let us know at least 24 hours before. Later cancellations may be charged.
